description:
All works part of general maintenance. Customer planted all of these trees and likes to maintain them to her particular standard.

T2 Hawthorn crown reduction by 1/1.5m all round

T3 Juniper Retrim all round by 0.5m and thin canopy by 10% to allow more light through the canopy.

T4-T5 (Rear Grd)	Yew x 2	Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by up to 1/1.5 metres and thin inner canopy by 10% to allow more light through the canopy. as requested on day. 	

T6 Prunus Retrim all round by 1/1.5m and thin canopy by 10% to allow more light through the canopy.
T7 Magnolia Retrim all round by 1/1.5m and thin canopy by 10% to allow more light through the canopy.
T8 Acer Retrim all round by 1/1.5 m and thin canopy by 10% to allow more light through the canopy.
T9 Hawthorn Retrim all round by 1/1.5m and thin canopy by 10% to allow more light through the canopy.

G1	Leyland Cypress	Retrim all round by 0.5m and thin canopy by 10% to allow more light through the canopy.

Customer would like this thinned as we did previously for her to allow more light through the hedge. 

Must run ALL works through with customer before/during and after works.
